Formats dialog on Store lists 10 optimized formats; every tested format-download-* link resolves to /api/rendering/asset/... with ?download=true and returns HTTP 200 attachment (KDP eBook, KDP Print 6x9, Etsy Listing all verified). Read Sample links return 302 → real preview HTML asset (HTTP 200, 2.1 MB). No 'Something went wrong' anywhere. 8/8 pytest backend tests pass; all 3 frontend browser flows pass (Buy→Stripe, full paid E2E with delivery, Formats+Preview+bogus session).

issues: Minor UX: An unknown session_id currently ends in the 'Payment is processing' state after 6 poll attempts (~12s) because CheckoutSuccess.js swallows the 404 from /commerce/checkout/status inside a bare try/except. Not a bug per problem statement (no generic error is shown, requirement met), but a strict fallback would render the 'We couldn't confirm the payment' error state on a 404 rather than optimistically polling. Consider distinguishing 404 (definitively unknown) from transient 5xx in the poll loop.

critical_code_review_comments: CheckoutSuccess.js line ~45: `catch (_) {}` inside the poll swallows all errors including a 404 (unknown session_id) and a 401/403 (unauthenticated). Consider treating a 404 on status as an immediate 'error' state instead of continuing to poll — improves UX for genuinely bad session IDs (currently degrades to 'Payment is processing' after 12s).

commerce.py purchase_download: currently returns the first customer file / cover as a fallback if `customer_deliverable.files` is empty (lines 176-181). This is a good graceful fallback but means we may deliver a preview PDF or the cover PNG as the 'purchased file' when a product has not yet been fully manufactured. Consider gating fallback behind an explicit product flag or logging a warning when fallback is used, so partial manufacture doesn't silently ship low-quality deliverables.

Store.js Formats modal (line ~163): `format-download-*` anchors always target=_blank. Good. But they open on the current page's window origin; if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is misconfigured the concatenated href silently breaks. Consider validating REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL once at module load and throwing early (not a fix needed now, tested URL is correct).

commerce.py create_checkout: the error string 'We couldn't start checkout right now. Please try again in a moment.' is customer-facing and clear — good. However, the underlying Stripe exception is only logger.error'd — no alert/observability hook. Consider integrating log_org(...'error') so Founders see Stripe failures in the Command Console.

No cleanup of TEST_ prefixed data: test_iteration24_delivery.py currently leaves `initiated` payment_transactions in the DB for every checkout test run. Low priority — they aren't paid so they don't impact revenue metrics — but a teardown fixture would tidy this.
